traits.aiDescription: The player is remarkably resilient. They withstand more damage and recover from wounds faster than most.
traits.name: Iron Constitution
traits.playerDescription: Hard to hurt, quick to mend.

traits.aiDescription: The player can sustain hard physical effort for a long time, at the cost of a fast metabolism that burns through food.
traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Built for the long haul, but the engine wants fuel.

traits.aiDescription: The player is adapted to harsh conditions. They need less food than most and shake off poisons faster.
traits.name: Survivalist
traits.playerDescription: Needs less, endures more.

traits.aiDescription: The player stays calm under pressure. Fear passes through them and drains away quickly.
traits.name: Zen Master
traits.playerDescription: The dark is just the dark.

traits.aiDescription: The player thrives on danger. They have deeper energy reserves and recover faster, but their nerves never fully settle.
traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.playerDescription: Fear is fuel. It just never quite switches off.

traits.aiDescription: Eating soothes the player. Their fear fades fast, but their appetite runs ahead of their supplies.
traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.playerDescription: Calm comes by the mouthful.

traits.aiDescription: The player tolerates toxins far better than most and purges them faster.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: A gut that argues with poison, and usually wins.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat large amounts when food is there and draws more from every meal.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: You can eat big when the chance comes, and it carries you farther.

traits.aiDescription: The player notices what others miss: a wrong color on a cap, a too-still shadow, a hunter's sign before the hunter. They walk into danger far less often.
traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.playerDescription: You see the wrong color and the too-still shadow before they see you.

traits.aiDescription: The player moves slowly and carefully, testing each step, breathing shallow and touching nothing. They are very hard to hear or track, but they cover ground slowly, and the strain tires them.
traits.name: Move Quietly
traits.playerDescription: Slow, tested steps and shallow breathing. Hard to track, and tiring.

traits.aiDescription: The wood turns the player in circles. Every path except east bends back toward the Drowned Hollow, and the player keeps finding their own tracks. East, the way the lantern moths drift at dusk, is the one direction that keeps going.
traits.name: The Veil's Hold
traits.playerDescription: Every path but east bends back toward the heart of the wood, and the hunters learn a little more of you each turn.

traits.aiDescription: The player is badly poisoned and hallucinates. Each turn, weave one false sight or sound into the real wood, built from what the scene already holds, with nothing to mark it as false. The real hunters and the real way east are still among them.
traits.name: Veil Sight
traits.playerDescription: The poison shows you things that aren't there. It passes when Toxin falls below 75%.

Shaken. The light answers slowly and dimly.
Steady. The Ember listens.
Radiant. Warmth answers before the prayer is finished.

stats.name: Faith

stats.description: How widely Emberwatch knows Corvin Vale. Good stories and true rumors raise it; lies that unravel lower it.

descriptors.description: Unknown. One more face on the frontier road.
Noticed. The keep's people know the name and watch what it does.
Known. Doors open; favors are asked and owed.
Famed. Songs at the Cinder and Crown, and a captain's ear on demand.

stats.name: Renown

stats.description: Corvin Vale's arcane power. His spells drain it; rest and study restore it.

descriptors.description: Drained. The weave slips away from every attempt to grasp it.
Low. A spell or two left before the well runs dry.
Steady. Enough power for a fight's worth of magic.
Brimming. Power hums under the skin.

stats.name: Mana

stats.description: How much harm the player's body can take. Lower it for falls, bites and poison. Raise it when a mushroom's effects mend the player.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.

Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Health

stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and wading. Lower it for hard effort. Raise it when the player rests or eats a mushroom that restores it.

Anxious. High tension, prone to emotional outbursts, decision-making impaired.
Mental breakdown. Overwhelmed by stress, irrational behavior, risk of panic attacks.

stats.name: Stress

stats.description: How fed the player is. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Starving. Intense hunger pains, weak and dizzy, risk of fainting, decreased cognitive function.
Hungry. Strong desire for food, stomach growling, difficulty concentrating.
Peckish. Slight hunger, starting to think about food.
Satisfied. Full, no desire for food.

stats.name: Satiety

stats.description: Poison in the player's body. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Clear. No poison worth naming; senses steady.
Queasy. A metallic taste; colors slightly too bright.
Poisoned. Stomach cramps, cold sweat, sounds arriving late.
Overwhelmed. The wood melts and rearranges, and nothing the player sees or hears can be trusted.

stats.name: Toxin

traitGroups.name: Constitution
traitGroups.playerDescription: What your body brings to a bad week.

traitGroups.name: Temperament
traitGroups.playerDescription: How your mind meets the dark.

traitGroups.name: Instincts
traitGroups.playerDescription: Instincts worth having in a place like this.

traitGroups.aiDescription: The Veilwood's hold on the player:
traitGroups.name: Curse
traitGroups.playerDescription: What the wood does to you. You don't pick these.

traits.aiDescription: The player is remarkably resilient. They withstand more damage and recover from wounds faster than most.
traits.name: Iron Constitution
traits.playerDescription: Hard to hurt, quick to mend.

traits.aiDescription: The player can sustain hard physical effort for a long time, at the cost of a fast metabolism that burns through food.
traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Built for the long haul, but the engine wants fuel.

traits.aiDescription: The player is adapted to harsh conditions. They need less food than most and shake off poisons faster.
traits.name: Survivalist
traits.playerDescription: Needs less, endures more.

traits.aiDescription: The player stays calm under pressure. Fear passes through them and drains away quickly.
traits.name: Zen Master
traits.playerDescription: The dark is just the dark.

traits.aiDescription: The player thrives on danger. They have deeper energy reserves and recover faster, but their nerves never fully settle.
traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.playerDescription: Fear is fuel. It just never quite switches off.

traits.aiDescription: Eating soothes the player. Their fear fades fast, but their appetite runs ahead of their supplies.
traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.playerDescription: Calm comes by the mouthful.

traits.aiDescription: The player tolerates toxins far better than most and purges them faster.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: A gut that argues with poison, and usually wins.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat large amounts when food is there and draws more from every meal.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: You can eat big when the chance comes, and it carries you farther.

traits.aiDescription: The player notices what others miss: a wrong color on a cap, a too-still shadow, a hunter's sign before the hunter. They walk into danger far less often.
traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.playerDescription: You see the wrong color and the too-still shadow before they see you.

traits.aiDescription: The wood turns the player in circles. Every path except east bends back toward the Drowned Hollow, and the player keeps finding their own tracks. East, the way the lantern moths drift at dusk, is the one direction that keeps going.
traits.name: The Veil's Hold
traits.playerDescription: Every path but east bends back toward the heart of the wood, and the hunters learn a little more of you each turn.

traits.aiDescription: The player is badly poisoned and hallucinates. Each turn, weave one false sight or sound into the real wood, built from what the scene already holds, with nothing to mark it as false. The real hunters and the real way east are still among them.
traits.name: Veil Sight
traits.playerDescription: The poison shows you things that aren't there. It passes when Toxin falls below 75%.

traits.aiDescription: The player moves slowly and carefully, testing each step, breathing shallow and touching nothing. They are very hard to hear or track, but they cover ground slowly, and the strain tires them.
traits.name: Move Quietly
traits.playerDescription: Slow, tested steps and shallow breathing. Hard to track, and tiring.
